{"subject":"Claim C019675 (PT0102, DOS 2026-10-22): EVV visit confirmation needed","body":"Hello,

No EVV visit is recorded for this patient and date, and the claim cannot be fixed by editing it. Per the blocker on file, we should not bill it unless the visit is found.

Could you confirm whether this visit took place and was recorded in EVV? If it did, please send the visit details so the claim can be corrected and reviewed. If it did not, please let us know so we can close the claim.

Thank you."}
